'''Pontypridd United FC''' (formerly '''Pontypridd Town AFC''') is a Welsh [[association football|football]] club, based in [[Pontypridd]], [[Rhondda Cynon Taf]]. The club plays at USW Sports Park on Treforest Industrial Estate. The club plays in the {{Welsh football updater|Pontypr}}.<ref>{{cite web |title=Mens Teams |url=https://www.pontypriddunited.co.uk/men |access-date=29 December 2025 |website=Pontypridd United}}</ref>"}}
